visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black and white maid outfit with a white face mask and a choker dances in a modern living room setting. The room features a large spherical woven lamp and a grey sofa. Large, stylized text overlays appear sequentially. (2) A fast-paced montage begins: the man appears in a blue puffer jacket in a snowy forest, then next to a pink car with a child waving from the sunroof. Subsequent cuts show him with a black cat-ear filter, riding a tricycle at night, taking mirror selfies with a woman, and a close-up of him in a bathrobe touching the woman's chin. (3) The montage continues with the man in underwear in a room, then in a fluffy white coat, followed by shots of him with the woman at a themed attraction, kissing another man outdoors, and a final shot carrying the man from the first scene. (4) The screen transitions to a mobile phone interface recording. The user navigates through various app icons, opens an app called Filmora, and searches for the '2025' template. The video demonstrates selecting a template and previews a skydiving video with similar text overlays. (5) The video ends on a dark screen displaying the Wondershare Filmora logo and a search bar icon.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic pop track. A male voice with a deep resonance speaks the words 'And with that' in English, synchronized with the bass beat. (2) As the montage kicks in, a female vocal track sings the lyrics 'Somebody like you' over a bright, synthesized melody with a steady 4/4 drum machine kick. (3) At the midpoint, the music volume lowers slightly to accommodate a clear, friendly male Mandarin narrator explaining the editing process. (4) Distinct digital 'click' and 'tap' sound effects are audible, mimicking the user interaction on the smartphone screen recording. (5) The narration continues with an instructional tone until a final synthesized stinger sound marks the appearance of the brand logo, and the music fades.
